id: title:jabahamondes:retry in body rate limits mid pagination

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion reliability for TikTok Ads connector; distinguishes transient API errors in response body from benign 200 responses, potentially reducing ingestion failures.
review.reason: Adds typed dict fields and a helper to classify HTTP responses by JSON body values, not just status or raw text. P1.F1.H1: P1.F1.H1
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the existence of transient API errors carrying status-like information in the response body (e.g., TikTok 40100) rather than the status code; while the implementation supports this, the actual occurrence and frequency of such errors are not demonstrated in the provided observations. No tests or rollback behavior are explicitly shown in the supplied hunk.
